high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an informational page about Hebbian learning, which is summarized as "cells that fire together, wire together." The page is part of an AI overview section, indicated by the title at the top left corner. Summary of Hebbian Learning: The main text explains that Hebbian learning is a principle in neuroscience and AI where the connection strength (synapse) between two neurons increases if they are repeatedly active at the same time, forming stronger associations and memories.
